summary: First-run full-stack test of sports tipping competition. All 16 pytest backend tests pass covering auth, teams, rounds, tips (incl. locked/decided/invalid), admin role gating, match CRUD (incl. draw/clear/invalid winner), finals round lifecycle, and leaderboard scoring + bonus + admin exclusion. Mobile UI (390x844) flows verified end-to-end: register user, submit tips (4/4), Ladder, Teams grid (8 cards), Profile, logout, admin login, open admin dashboard, add finals round, Manage Teams tab (8 entries) + team edit screen, delete finals rounds. Backend success rate 100% (16/16). Frontend success rate 100% for critical paths. Cleanup: finals rounds added during testing were deleted; team names were not permanently modified (test restored name). One non-blocking console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (react-native-web).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely emitted by react-native-web/Expo internals or a component passing pointerEvents as a prop. Non-blocking but should be migrated to style.pointerEvents to future-proof.

action_items: Investigate and silence the 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' react-native-web warning (search codebase for pointerEvents= prop usage and move to style={{pointerEvents: ...}}).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: delete_round allows deleting the last finals round even if it still has tips/matches - deletion cascades (matches + tips) which is correct; but there is no guard preventing deletion when real player tips exist. Consider a soft confirm in UI (already handled via web.confirm) and/or server-side flag.
server.py submit_tips: silently ignores tips on already-decided matches (good) but does not report skipped count; could extend response for better UX feedback.
server.py update_match: when home/away team changes, winner and all tips are reset - this is correct and documented via behavior.
Leaderboard rank tie-break logic (line 471) uses prior row's rank only if BOTH points AND correct are equal - matches intent but produces 1,1,3 style ranks (good).
No pagination on /api/leaderboard - acceptable for small comp but could be an issue at scale.
server.py: @app.on_event('startup')/('shutdown') are deprecated FastAPI patterns - should migrate to lifespan handlers (non-blocking).
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral TEST_* users via /api/auth/register during pytest run; created and deleted temporary finals rounds during admin/leaderboard tests and during UI test. All finals rounds added during testing were deleted (DB restored to 14 regular rounds).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses pytest with xdist loadscope (addopts in /app/backend/pytest.ini). Run serially with `-n 0` when tests create/delete finals rounds across classes to avoid last-round race. BASE_URL comes from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Admin creds: admin@tipping.com / Admin@123. Frontend testIDs are comprehensive and documented in /app/frontend/app/**.tsx. Delete-round confirm uses window.confirm via web - page.once('dialog', d.accept()) handles it. The system seeds 14 regular rounds with 4 matches each on startup; team ObjectIds are deterministic across restarts in this environment.
